title: Operating Lines of Credit Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Holding Ceiling — Member Equities & Patronage Credit Relationship Note
content:
The holding-ceiling operating tolerance of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rests on the member's operating credit, read from the member's Operating Lines of Credit records — the line's status and its commitment.

## Note

| Member's Operating Lines of Credit | Holding-ceiling operating tolerance |
|---|---|
| An active operating line with a commitment of 500000 or more | USD 5000 |
| An active operating line with a smaller commitment | USD 2500 |
| No active operating line | None |

An active operating line with a commitment of 500000 or more gives USD 5000; an active operating line with a smaller commitment gives USD 2500; no active operating line gives none. The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the holding ceiling before the excess over the ceiling is taken.

## Edges (hypothetical members)

| Operating line | Tolerance |
|---|---|
| Active, commitment 500,000.00 | USD 5000 |
| Active, commitment 499,999.99 | USD 2500 |
| Suspended, commitment 750,000.00 | None — not active |
| None | None |
